epic: Epic 0002 — Performance, Fidelity, and Material Modes
activation: Create a clean disposable worktree on codex/engine-roadmap. Run with RALPH_PRD=.ralph/prd-engine-roadmap.json and RALPH_PROMPT=.ralph/PROMPT-engine-roadmap.md. Run OPS-001 first; never point the pre-OPS runner at the primary checkout.
status_legend: todo/in_progress are Ralph work; human pauses for explicit approval and must be set to done or cut by a person; gated remains dormant until its evidence gate fires; done/cut are terminal; blocked requires human repair.
selection: Choose the first todo/in_progress task whose dependencies are done. Skip human/gated/cut/blocked tasks. If unfinished todo work exists only behind human dependencies, emit HUMAN_GATE_REACHED and stop without counting a failure.
global_gate: For GL/shader/lifecycle stories also bun run test:browser
For public/demo stories also bun run build
global_constraints: One story per iteration and one green commit per completed story.
No pushes, merges, releases, or human visual sign-off from Ralph.
No runtime dependencies and no architecture-invariant violations.
Experimental model controls stay out of public exports, dist typings, docs, navigation, sitemap, and main demo until API promotion.
ADR numbers are claimed only at implementation time.

tasks.title: Harden Ralph execution isolation and human-gate semantics
tasks.spec: Require a disposable-worktree marker, reject main and the primary checkout, constrain failure cleanup to loop-owned changes, and distinguish complete, human-gated, and blocked stops.
acceptance: Failed-task fixture preserves a pre-existing untracked sentinel
Human-gated dependency stops once with HUMAN_GATE_REACHED
Shell syntax and helper tests pass
tasks.notes: Completed on the roadmap branch. The runner now resolves the selected PRD, rejects primary/unmarked worktrees, preserves baseline untracked files during recovery, and stops distinctly at human/blocked gates.

tasks.title: Make governor overload duration genuinely sustained
tasks.spec: Separate continuous-overload duration from time since action; reset/decay it below budget and make observable action state stable.
acceptance: Continuous overload waits the full interval
tasks.notes: Continuous overload and cooldown are separate; recovery and pause break streaks; one frame contributes at most 250 ms; invalid samples are ignored; lastAction remains observable until reset. Node/check/prepack and the targeted real-browser governor suite pass.

tasks.title: Decouple frame budget from simulation time
tasks.spec: Add refresh-aware or explicit target-frame semantics and separate catch-up delta clamping from quality substeps.
acceptance: Substep shedding does not change accepted wall-clock delta
Any public field is forwarded, documented, tested, and changesetted
tasks.notes: Added explicit autoPerformanceTargetFrameMs semantics, separated requested config from effective shed quality, preserved the legacy catch-up delta across substep shedding, and covered 30/60/120 Hz classification, forwarding, docs, packaging, and browser behavior.

tasks.title: Guard MacCormack departure paths near solids
tasks.spec: Fall back to semi-Lagrangian advection when the departure segment or limiter stencil crosses blocked faces.
acceptance: Thin-wall flux does not worsen versus SL
Dipole retention and NaN soak stay green

tasks.title: Correct context restore and duplicate glass allocation
tasks.spec: Preserve the configured opening-state policy across restore and remove duplicate scene-FBO allocation on construction/restore.
acceptance: Configured/random splats are neither lost nor doubled
Glass allocates once per required transition
tasks.notes: Context restore now abandons invalid GL handles, freshly allocates all FBO groups, resets the seeded opening lifecycle, and replays value-snapshotted random/preset splats once. Glass scene-FBO allocation is explicit and single-owner. ADR-0051 plus real WEBGL_lose_context readback and allocation-balance coverage added; 499 node and 21 browser tests pass.

tasks.title: Run browser tests in CI
tasks.spec: Add an isolated Playwright Chromium job with explicit installation, timeout, caching, and failure artifacts.
acceptance: All current browser tests run on PR/main
Deliberate branch failure proves the job gates
tasks.notes: Added an independent 20-minute Chromium job with pinned Bun, lockfile-pinned Playwright, explicit browser/dependency installation, cached browser binaries, failure logs/artifacts, and no secret requirements. Local browser and full repository gates pass; remote branch-failure validation remains part of the release gate.

tasks.title: Correct existing Plasma product language
tasks.spec: Describe current Plasma as a visual fluid preset, not a magnetic-pinch or discharge simulation, without changing its name/output.
acceptance: Public descriptions are honest and consistent
tasks.notes: Reframed Plasma consistently as a plasma-inspired visual fluid preset, explicitly disclaimed plasma-physics behavior, preserved the exported component/config, and added public-copy/generated-agent regression tests.

tasks.title: Human 0.8.0 go/no-go
tasks.spec: Human reviews full local/remote gates, changesets, real-browser behavior, and the Version Packages PR.
tasks.notes: Human sets done after release approval or cut/blocked with the failed criterion.

tasks.title: Profile the whole frame and lifecycle
tasks.spec: Measure compile/link, allocation, resize, solver/post/display groups, draw count, pixels, estimated texture bytes, renderer/browser/DPR, with GPU timers and CPU fallback.

tasks.title: Split framebuffer ownership
tasks.spec: Separate simulation, dye/scalar, post-process, mask, and presentation resource transitions without changing output.
acceptance: Dye-only changes do not recreate simulation/post resources
tasks.notes: Dye/scalar, simulation, post-process, mask-derived, and presentation ownership is explicit with named fresh/preserve transitions. Config patches touch each affected group once; scalar presence never rebuilds dye; context restore freshly rebuilds all groups and invalidates MacCormack clearance. ADR-0055 plus framebuffer identity/count/balance coverage added; 525 node and 27 browser tests pass.

tasks.title: Add state-preserving FluidEngine.resize
tasks.spec: Resize drawing buffer and affected resources while preserving context, programs, masks, and resampled persistent fields.

tasks.title: Use in-place resize from Fluid.svelte
tasks.spec: Replace resize teardown/rebuild with coalesced engine.resize while preserving deliberate lazy teardown and one-shot rebuild fallback.

tasks.title: Separate CSS quality from physical DPR
tasks.spec: Add maxPixelRatio default 2 with opt-out; use CSS dimensions for quality tiers and physical dimensions for allocation caps.
acceptance: DPR fixtures choose identical CSS tiers

tasks.title: Lazy optional framebuffer groups
tasks.spec: Allocate bloom, sunrays, glass, optional scalar, and future model resources only while active.

tasks.title: Compile only selected shader variants
tasks.spec: Prewarm only programs required by resolved config; compile optional variants during explicit transitions, never unpredictably in first draw.

tasks.title: Dirty rendering while paused
tasks.spec: Render paused scenes only after input, resize, relevant config changes, or explicit invalidation.
acceptance: Stable paused scene has zero draws

tasks.title: Skip provably empty solver work
tasks.spec: Track conservative never-activated velocity/source state and skip solver draws only when emptiness is provable.
acceptance: Empty scene has zero solver draws

tasks.title: Human lifecycle/performance qualification
tasks.spec: Human reviews pinned baseline, resize/context behavior, and leak evidence.
acceptance: Existing suite within 5% median GPU regression
Target scenarios improve or are justified
No memory growth across lifecycle cycles

tasks.title: Resolution and projection sweep
tasks.spec: Measure divergence RMS/max, energy, grid-scale energy, peak velocity, and solid-face flux at 64/96/128/192/256 including both paired-Jacobi regimes.

tasks.title: Normalize adaptive vorticity gating
tasks.spec: Make adaptive omega thresholds resolution-invariant and test the real low/transition/high bands.
acceptance: CPU known answers cover all bands
Equivalent fields resolve equivalent mix across sweep

tasks.title: Internal RK2 midpoint backtrace
tasks.spec: Add construct-only RK2 velocity backtrace with one extra sample and no extra pass or FBO.

tasks.title: Human RK2 comparative decision
tasks.spec: Compare Euler/RK2/MacCormack metrics, GPU cost, and appearance; accept, retain-dark, or reject RK2.
acceptance: Metric table and pinned environment recorded

tasks.title: Reproduce or close fractional-aperture gate
tasks.spec: Add curved-cylinder, narrow-throat, and subcell-wall scenes measuring flux, divergence, symmetry, and adjacent spectral energy.
acceptance: Shipping-relevant defect reproduced or gate stays closed

tasks.title: Implement fractional face apertures
tasks.gate: FID-005 reproduces a shipping-relevant defect and a human activates the task
tasks.spec: Supersample face openness and apply identical face-weighted divergence, pressure diagonal, and adjoint gradient across all pressure stencil sites behind an internal variant.

tasks.title: Human fractional-aperture promotion decision
tasks.spec: Choose reject, internal-dark, or targeted enablement from measured and visual evidence.
acceptance: Decision, resource cost, affected presets, and rollback recorded

tasks.title: Cheap pressure convergence ladder
tasks.gate: FID-001 demonstrates a shipping-relevant pressure under-convergence defect
tasks.spec: Try more paired iterations, then Chebyshev/red-black, then at most one two-grid smoother; recursive multigrid remains cut.
acceptance: Smallest option meeting divergence/flux target selected
No default change without human visual/performance approval
